title: Dice's BetterExperiece
description: It is my modpack for playing on some servers. It has a lot of optimisation and QOL mods.
body:
Hello, comrade! I'm sharing with you my personal modpack for playing on servers and in the singleplayer. It also contains several nice mods that improve the usual interaction with the game. Of course, all this is on the client side. I won't keep you any longer, have a nice game!

And finally, look at what a cool screenshot I took!
